name: Rot and Regret
summary: Woodwyrd, the ghost of an ancient treant at the Forlorn Gardens, asks you to put out the flame that still burns him. He points you toward sacred water in Maraudon.

sections.title: A Spirit's Burden
sections.body: The ancient spirit says its final mistake binds it to this place, where it still feels a flame in death. It asks you to seek pristine water from a sacred ravine across Mashan’she. Maraudon is the place named, and the spirit is Woodwyrd himself, who awaits the Vial of Earth Song Water at the Forlorn Gardens.

faq.q: Who is asking for the water?
faq.answer: Woodwyrd asks for it himself. He is the ghostly ancient at the Forlorn Gardens, and the water is to put out his flame.

faq.q: Why does the ancient spirit want the flame put out?
faq.answer: The spirit says it is burdened by its last mistake and still feels the flame in death.

faq.q: Where can I find the sacred water?
faq.answer: The spirit points you to Maraudon, across Mashan’she, for pristine water from a sacred ravine.
Woodwyrd asks you to bring back a Vial of Earth Song Water.

attribution: In-game quest text: Rot and Regret
